title: Propagating the 100 % MSSI uncertainty into the local and global significance: what a factor-2, factor-10 or mis-shaped wall/RFR background does to the 3.4 sigma
question: How does the L10 local and global significance respond when the MSSI nuisance prior is widened (log-normal x2/x4.5/x10, flat), the MSSI central value is raised (x2-x977), the wall depth scale is varied (1.23-8 cm, annulus-anchored), the (S1c, d) shape is deformed or RFR is scaled, with LZ's six wall sideband bins profiled in the same likelihood; what minimal rate x shape deformation gives Z_local < 2 sigma and is it excluded by LZ's own sidebands?
headline_result: In P052's reconstructed LZ likelihood the MSSI channel is worth 0.19 sigma (3.11 -> 3.29 without MSSI); with the six wall sideband bins profiled no prior or common rate factor moves Z (3.17 +- 0.01 sigma); only sideband-invisible shape errors matter: depth scale 4.3 cm (FV x7.3) gives 2.76 sigma position-blind but 3.16 position-aware, all MSSI at S1c>500 gives 2.67; Z<2 needs f*g = 54, excluded (p ~ 1e-71) as a rate or contradicting Fig. 5 as a shape.
model_or_mechanism: P052 three-sample (S1c,d) profile likelihood with log-parametrised t_MSSI, Gaussian/log-normal/flat priors, FV rate factor, six-wall-bin Poisson sideband terms (common or FV-only), replaceable MSSI map, position weight; annulus-anchored f_lambda from P079 ratios; position PDF from P070 volume profile; N_eff(Z) from P071
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13, numpy 2.5.3, scipy 1.18.1, pandas 3.0.5, matplotlib 3.11.2, iminuit 2.32.0, P052 engine header (Pillow 12.3.0; nestpy/WimPyDD caches), common/lzcommon.py
local_inputs: fulltext.tex Tables I/S1/S2, MSSI text l.184-196/300-320, supplement l.710-785; P052 script+results; P070 profiles_d.csv/LR_table; P079 annulus ratios; P004 k limits; P033/P073 summaries; P071 N_eff table; 11 papers; ledger
recalled_knowledge: 4 (Z=sqrt(q0) asymptotics; one-sided 95% at 2.71; Sidak p_global form; log-normal for factor uncertainties) all certain
